chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: Leaving Cafe Society for Indianapolis, the Ferguson agency and Little Bo's band
summary: After Carnegie Hall he stayed at Cafe Society until he went to Indianapolis and joined a young Philadelphia band.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh, that's been about six...seven months ago. An' gettin' back to that, I'm way ahead of myself. After I played in

Carnegie Hall in New York City, I went back to Cafe Society, while we were workin' there, and I stayed there so long until that I was one of the fixtures in the place, so I finally took off and went to Indianapolis.

I run up on a fellow named Ferguson, had a bookin' agency. So I got hung up with him. So he had a band out of Philadelphia-- a bunch of young kids called Little Bo's (?) Band. And we was, uh... we got together. They could play all that Count Basie, Duke Ellington an' ever'body. Had a little bit o' ever'body music in their band. Bunch o' young kids. So I toured all over the South with 'em, all of em' up North 'n' everywhere with 'em. We had us a ball.
